name: Purge
short: Moderator-only message cleanup by amount, user, bots, links, text and media.
description: Purge messages in the current text channel or thread by count, member or ID, bots, webhooks, links, attachments, embeds, keyword, and before/after message IDs. Per-command cap of 500 deletions, scanned history cap of 5000, and confirmation when deleting more than 100. Filters default to scanning the last 1000 messages.
author: Will
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not retain, log, or persist any end-user data. It reads message history to execute staff-requested deletions and stores only the IDs of channels with active purge operations in volatile memory. Messages are deleted from Discord and cannot be restored by this cog.
install_msg: Purge installed. Run [p]load purge, then [p]purge 25, [p]purge user @member 25, or [p]help purge. Only moderators/members with Manage Messages can use the commands. The bot needs Manage Messages and Read Message History.
